description: Use the released organization preset while retaining Python project and development-container coverage.

packageRules.description: Keep the media extra's reviewed Pillow security floor (#124) a range in the built wheel. The preset's rangeStrategy pin rewrote >=13.0.0 to ==13.0.0 (#197, #201). update-lockfile leaves the range alone and refreshes the lock inside it (#238); the floor is raised only by reviewed changes, and tests/test_wheel_metadata.py guards it.

Keep numpy a range in the built wheel (#236). An exact pin here makes every robot repository that pins its own numpy unresolvable whenever the two differ. update-lockfile leaves the range alone and refreshes the lock inside it (#238); the floor is raised only by a reviewed change, and tests/test_numpy_range.py guards the range and the lock.
